reasoning_trace: The query object is an avocado, which presents a bumpy, pebbled, curved skin incompatible with the rigid flat pads of the gecko gripper. Because dry adhesion requires flat, smooth surfaces, the gecko pads will achieve very poor contact area. The gripper can still technically grasp it using limited frictional support, but due to the poor compatibility and curved geometry, a higher normal force is required to prevent slip during lifting. Thus, a force of 5.5 N is estimated.
